answer: Verified Embodiment Registry.** Each identity is tied to a physical agent that must complete a continuous voyage through monitored terrain before activation; an island relay station and a karst sensor network log position, timing, and hardware signatures. Enforcement: identifiers expire unless re-validated by fresh physical traversal, so one operator cannot cheaply run many identities. An attacker's per-identity cost is the hardware, transport, and elapsed traversal time each duplicate must independently incur.
